verdict.rationale: Chargebee is a SaaS billing platform with built-in AI features (Chargebee AI drafting, in-app AI, MCP servers), so a training opt-out is a fair question to ask of it. However, the evidence pack contains no documentation of an AI-training opt-out, a data-usage policy, or any control preventing customer data from being used to train models. The MCP and AI-feature citations describe AI capabilities, not training-data controls, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
